name: Futaba Aoi
source:
She used to work for the Japanese Immigration Bureau as a special interrogator.
She's currently guarding Eris.
She has a special power called 'Aports' that lets her teleport objects into her hand.
Her hobby is watching DVD's and she's Kio's classmate.
